column1: # console-tunables-consumers - the 97 .data addresses the console's arms touch, with what names them and who reads them (FABLE, 2026-09-17).
# arm_ids / labels: from Tools/work/repos-d2/console_arms.tsv and console-command-names.md. setting_name: the string key the scene-config loaders

#   001C7940 / 001C3D50 store into the address (the key whose lea precedes the map lookup 001FF740 that precedes the store; corrected 2026-09-17, the first version took the nearest lea in 008FA700..008FAB00 and mis-keyed most block stores). outside_readers: functions referencing the
#   address other than the console 001D1660, the menu filler 001CD0E0 and the two loaders (rip-target census of .text).
# in_block: 1 when the address lies in the 1,132-byte block at 02CB7FD0.
